# 首页、全局搜索与分栏工作台 / Home, global search & split workbench

> 功能 / Feature

从首页总览快速进入常用资产与设备，按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 一键搜索消息、文件、命令与设置，并用双栏工作台或悬浮窗自由组织屏幕空间。

Jump into agents, apps, skills, and devices from Home, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K to search messages, files, commands, and settings anywhere, and arrange work across split panes or a compact floating window.

## 适用场景 / When to use it

- 刚打开 OpenBitFun 想找上次聊到一半的方案，但忘了在哪个项目：直接按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 输入关键词，就能跨会话消息、文件名和功能说明一起定位。
  - Looking for a discussion from last week across several repos? Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and type a phrase to search past messages, sessions, files, and settings all at once.
- 平时高频使用「智能体」「小应用」或「洞察」：去「设置 → 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」把它们固定到「首页」下方，不用每次翻找。
  - Use Agents, Mini Apps, or Insights every day? Pin them right below Home in Settings → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar.
- 在浏览器查文档或盯着设计稿修改逻辑时：点左下角齿轮菜单切到「悬浮窗模式」，让对话缩成不挡视线的轻量悬浮窗随时待命。
  - Reading specs or reviewing designs in another app? Switch to Floating window mode from the bottom-left gear menu to keep a compact AI bar handy.

## 完整功能清单 / Everything included

- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能
  - Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills
  - 说明：首页汇集了累计与单日峰值 Token、连续使用天数热力图、同账号在线设备卡片，以及创建智能体、创建个人助理、启动已安装小应用和浏览技能市场的直达按钮。
  - Why & how: Home brings together token and streak metrics, an activity heatmap, same-account device cards, and one-click launchers to create agents or assistants, open Mini Apps, and discover Skills.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令
  - Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands
  - 说明：不管焦点在编辑器还是聊天框，按下快捷键即可呼出全局搜索；可在「全部 / 命令 / 内容」间切换范围，若当前接入了 Peer 对端设备，搜索也会自动针对当前显示设备执行。
  - Why & how: Open Global Search from any focus scope, filter by All, Commands (>), or Content, and jump straight to matching conversations, files, actions, or settings on the active device.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 在双栏工作台中并排查看会话与代码/终端，拖拽移动标签页或使用分屏快捷键
  - Work side by side in the split workbench with draggable tabs, pane maximize, and canvas overview shortcuts
  - 说明：在会话中点开文件或终端时会自动在另一侧分栏展示，每个会话独立记住自己的右侧面板开合状态；支持 ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ 分屏、⌘Shift+M 最大化当前栏、⌘Shift+E 打开标签总览、⌘Shift+T 恢复刚关闭的标签。
  - Why & how: Opening files or terminals beside a chat reveals the opposite pane automatically and remembers pane state per session; use ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ to split, ⌘Shift+M to maximize, ⌘Shift+E for overview, and ⌘Shift+T to reopen closed tabs.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标
  - Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts
  - 说明：左侧边栏默认精简保留「首页」与「任务看板」，避免视觉拥挤；你可以随时把「智能体」「助理」「小应用」「技能」「发现技能」「洞察」或已安装的 Mini App 固定到侧边栏并调整上下顺序。
  - Why & how: The sidebar starts clean with Home and Task Board pinned by default; pin Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, Skills, Discover Skills, Insights, or individual Mini Apps and reorder them anytime.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口
  - Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime
  - 说明：点击侧边栏左下角齿轮菜单中的「悬浮窗模式」，主窗口会收起为小巧的桌面悬浮条，方便你在阅读网页、文档或调试其他软件时随手提问，需要看代码时一键展开回完整工作台。
  - Why & how: Choose Floating window mode from the bottom-left gear menu to collapse OpenBitFun into a compact floating bar while working in other apps, then expand back to the full workbench in one click.

## 怎么用 / How to use it

1. 点击左侧边栏顶部的「首页」查看你的设备、智能体、小应用、小卡片和技能概览
   Click Home at the top of the left sidebar to see your devices, agents, Mini Apps, desktop cards, and Skills at a glance
2. 随时按 ⌘K（Windows/Linux 按 Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）打开全局搜索；直接输入文字搜会话与文件，输入 > 查看可执行命令
   Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K or Alt+F on Windows/Linux) anywhere to search sessions, files, features, and settings — or type > to filter commands
3. 在会话中点开任意文件或按 ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+` 打开终端，拖动顶部标签页即可在左右分栏间自由摆放
   Open any file or press ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+` for a terminal beside your chat, and drag tabs between left and right panes
4. 想把常用入口常驻在左侧边栏时，前往「设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,）→ 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」勾选并排序
   To keep favorite pages in the sidebar, go to Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar

入口 / Entry: 左侧边栏顶部「搜索一切」（⌘K / Ctrl+K）与「首页」入口；左下角齿轮菜单可切换「悬浮窗模式」 / Top of the left sidebar: Search everything (⌘K / Ctrl+K) and Home; use the bottom-left gear menu for Floating window mode (`⌘K / Ctrl+K`)

## 可以直接对智能体说 / Try saying

- “帮我打开键盘快捷键设置”
  - “Open keyboard shortcut settings for me”
- “带我去外观设置调整左侧导航栏”
  - “Take me to Appearance settings so I can customize the left sidebar”
- “打开任务看板看看今天有哪些计划任务”
  - “Open the Task Board so I can check today’s scheduled runs”

## 实用贴士 / Good to know

- 用 Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+3 可以快速聚焦顶部场景栏的前三个常驻标签；在右侧代码画布里用 ⌘1–9 / Ctrl+1–9 可直接切换编辑器标签。
  - Use Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+3 to jump between your first three top-level scene tabs, and ⌘1–9 / Ctrl+1–9 inside the editor canvas to switch file tabs.
- 按 ⌘B / Ctrl+B 可收起或展开左侧导航栏，按 ⌘Shift+B / Ctrl+Shift+B 可同时收起左右辅助面板，立刻获得沉浸式阅读视野。
  - Press ⌘B / Ctrl+B to toggle the left sidebar, or ⌘Shift+B / Ctrl+Shift+B to collapse side panels together when you want distraction-free focus.
- 侧边栏固定项保存在当前设备的界面偏好中，切换 Peer 对端设备时不会弄乱远端主机的配置。
  - Sidebar pin preferences stay local to your current controller window and never overwrite another Peer device’s config.

关联条目 / Related: `setting.application.appearance`, `setting.application.shortcuts`, `feature.projects`, `feature.ai-assistant`

智能体会先查找相关功能或设置，确认目标后再替你打开、执行或修改。完整能力目录不会预先塞进对话上下文。

The agent first finds the relevant feature or setting, confirms the target, and then opens, runs, or changes it for you. The full catalog is never embedded in the conversation context.
